Container.Name: RsyncWebUI
Container.Overview:
RsyncWebUI is a web interface for rsync. Pick one or more sources and a destination from a file browser, tick the rsync options you want, save it as a task, and let it repeat on a cron schedule. Every run shows a live log with a progress bar and is kept in a history.
Note: the container needs read and write access to the shares it backs up. By default /mnt/user and /mnt/disks are mounted.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Database of tasks and run history. An ssh directory with SSH keys can live here too.

Config.Name: Shares (/mnt/user)
Config.Description: Access to the Unraid shares. Sources and destinations are picked from here.

Config.Name: Unassigned Devices (/mnt/disks)
Config.Description: External drives from Unassigned Devices as a backup destination. The rw,slave mode makes drives plugged in later visible inside the container.

Config.Name: Remote Shares (/mnt/remotes)
Config.Description: Mounted SMB or NFS shares from Unassigned Devices.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for schedules. Should match the server timezone.

Config.Name: Allowed roots
Config.Description: Comma-separated paths the file browser may show. Anything outside is rejected.

Config.Name: Username (optional)
Config.Description: Enables simple access protection. Leave empty for no login.

Config.Name: Port (internal)
Config.Description: Port the web server listens on inside the container.
